gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Tests that a {@link JulianDate} created from a proleptic year is consistent with the equivalent date created from its era and year-of-era.

ADDED i2: For every proleptic year in a range spanning both eras, verify that:
  • the date reports the same proleptic year it was built from,
  • years at or b
